title: FATHER GOD, REFRESH MY SPIRIT AND RENEW MY STRENGTH FOR TODAY
text: Glory to God. I want you to do something for me this morning. Before we go into the place of prayer, I want you to share this prayer with somebody. There is somebody on your contact list. There is somebody in your family. There is somebody God has connected to your life and the enemy has been draining their strength. Share this prayer with them. The Bible says in Ecclesiastes 4:9-10, "Two are better than one because they have a good reward for their labor. For if they fall, the one will lift up his fellow." Share this now. Don't just keep this to yourself. There is a grace upon this altar. There is an anointing upon this word. And when you share it, you become a carrier of that grace. You become a distributor of divine strength. Share it now. And as you share it, may the Lord activate the spirit of refreshing upon your own life in Jesus mighty name. Now, I want you to understand something this morning. We're not just coming to pray routine prayers. We're coming to encounter the God who specializes in renewal. The God who took Elijah from under the juniper tree where he was suicidal. Where he said, "It is enough, Lord. Take my life." And gave him angels food. And that food strengthened him for 40 days and 40 nights. That same God is about to minister to you this morning. [music] I don't care how depleted you feel. I don't care how empty your spiritual tank has become. I don't care how many battles you fought. I decree that fresh oil is coming upon your life in the name of Jesus Christ. You see the scripture is very clear in Isaiah 40-29 31. He gives power to the weak and to those who have no might. He increases strength. Even the youth shall faint and be weary and the young men shall utterly fall. But those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength. They shall mount up with wings like eagles. [music] They shall run and not be weary. They shall walk and not faint. So this morning we are positioning ourselves as waiters upon the Lord. Not just people who are asking but people who are waiting, people who are ting, people who are expecting a divine encounter with the spirit of the living God. I need you to understand that spiritual exhaustion is real. Ministry is real. The demands of life are real. The Bible says in Galatians 6:9, "Let us not grow weary while doing good, for in due season we shall reap if we do not lose heart." So the fact that you are tired does not make you a bad Christian. The fact that you need refreshing does not mean you are weak in faith. Even Jesus the son of God had to withdraw to lonely places to pray. Even Jesus had to step away from the multitude. Even Jesus understood the principle of divine renewal. So this morning we are coming to the throne of grace that we may obtain mercy and find grace to help in time of need. Now let me show you something powerful in the scriptures. In Exodus 17 when the children of Israel were fighting against Amalecch, Moses stood on the hill with the rod of God in his hand. And the Bible says so it was when Moses held up his hand that Israel prevailed. And when he let down his hand, Amalecch prevailed. But here is what I want you to see. Moses' hands became heavy. The man of God, the deliverer, the one who brought them [music] out of Egypt, his hands became heavy. And what did Aaron and he do? They took a stone and put it under him, and he sat on it. And they supported his hands, one on one side, and one on the other side. And his hands were steady until the going down of the sun. This morning, the Holy Spirit is your aon and your hall. The Holy Spirit is coming to hold up your hands. The Holy Spirit is coming to support what has become heavy in your life. Let me pray for you right now. Lift up your hands wherever you are. Father, in the name of Jesus Christ, I come before you as a priest [music] in the office of prayer. Lord, I stand in the gap for every man and woman, every [music] young person under the sound of my voice. Father, I ask that you will release fresh strength right now by the authority of the word of God, by the power of the Holy Spirit, I decree that every form of weariness is broken now in Jesus name. Every spirit of heaviness, I command you to lift off their lives now. Psalm 3:3 says, "But you, oh Lord, are a shield for me, my glory, and the one who lifts up my head." So right now in the name of Jesus, I decree that their heads are being lifted, their spirits are being raised, their strength is being renewed. Father, let the rivers of living water begin to flow from their innermost being. Let the oil of joy replace the spirit of heaviness. Let the garment of praise replace the spirit of despair. And I declare that today is a day of divine turnaround. Isaiah 40-31 says, "But those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength." So right now as they are waiting, as they are positioned, as they are in the place of expectation, Lord, renew their strength. Give them eagle strength. Let them mount up with wings as eagles. Let them run and not be weary. Let them walk and not faint. I decrease supernatural stamina upon their lives. I decree supernatural grace upon their assignments. Every good work that you have called them to do, Father, release the strength for them to complete it. Release the grace for them to finish well. Release the anointing for them to overcome every obstacle in the mighty name of Jesus Christ. Now, somebody needs to hear this. The exhaustion you are feeling is not just physical. It is spiritual. The enemy has been targeting your joy. The enemy has been targeting your peace. The enemy has been targeting your passion for the things of God. But I decree that this morning marks the end of that siege. This morning marks the end of that spiritual drought. This morning marks the beginning of a fresh visitation. 2 Corinthians 4:16 says, "Therefore, we do not lose heart. Even though our outward man is perishing, yet the inward man is being renewed day by day. So your inward man is about to experience renewal such as you have never experienced before. You see when David was in the wilderness when he was being pursued by his enemies when everything seemed to be falling apart he made a very powerful declaration in Psalm 23. He said he restores my soul. Not he might restore not he will eventually restore but he restores. It is a present continuous action. It is something that God is doing consistently. So this morning, I declare over your life, he's restoring your soul. He's restoring your passion. He's restoring your fire. He's restoring your zeal. He's restoring your vision. He's restoring your focus. He's restoring everything the enemy has tried to steal, kill, and destroy in your life. Let me show you something about the pattern of divine refreshing. In 1 Kings 19, when Elijah ran into the wilderness, the Bible says he sat under a broom [music] tree and prayed that he might die. This is a prophet who just called down fire from heaven. This is a prophet who just slaughtered 450 prophets of Bale. This is a prophet who just outran a chariot. But sometimes after your greatest victory comes, your greatest battle with exhaustion. After your mountaintop experience comes the valley of weariness. But look at what God did. The Bible says, "An angel touched him and said, "Arise and eat. And when he looked, there was a cake baked on coals and a jar of water at his head." This morning, I decree that the angel of the Lord is touching you. The angel of the Lord is ministering to you. The angel of the Lord is bringing you supernatural sustenance. Eat from the table of the Lord. Drink from the wells of salvation. And that meal will sustain you for the journey ahead. Father, I thank you that you are not a God who is far off. You are not a God who is [music] distant. You are Jehovah Shama, the Lord who is present. You are Emmanuel, God with us. And so right now I decree that your presence is flooding every room, every space, every heart where this prayer is being prayed. Your presence is bringing renewal. Your presence is bringing refreshing. Your presence is bringing restoration. Acts 3:19 says, "Repent, therefore, and be converted that your sins may be blotted out so that times of refreshing may come from the presence of the Lord." So Lord, as we have positioned ourselves, as we have repented, as we have turned our hearts toward you, now release times of refreshing, let it come like rain. Let it come like rivers. Let it come like floods upon dry ground. I speak to your spirit man right now. I speak to that part of you that has been gasping for breath. I speak to that part of you that has been struggling to maintain. I speak to that part of you that has been wondering if you can continue. And I decree you shall receive power after that the Holy Ghost has come upon you. The same spirit that raised Christ from the dead is dwelling in you. And that spirit is quickening your mortal body. That spirit is bringing life to dead areas. That spirit is bringing strength to weak areas. That spirit is bringing victory to areas of defeat. Romans 8:11 says, "But if the spirit of him who raised Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised Christ from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his spirit who dwells in you. So right now, I command life to come into your mortal body. I command strength to flood your physical frame. I command energy to replace exhaustion. I command vitality to replace weariness. I command supernatural endurance to replace natural limitations. You are not operating by bread alone, but by every word that proceeds from the mouth of God. And the word of the Lord over your life this morning is strength. The word of the Lord over your life this morning is renewal. The word of the Lord over your life this morning is refreshing. The word of the Lord over your life this morning is restoration. Let me tell you something about the nature of God. His El Shadai, the allsufficient one. When Abraham was 99 years old and Sarah was 90, when their bodies were as good as dead, God appeared to Abraham and said, "I am El Shadai, the Almighty God." And that name El Shadai means the God of more than enough. The God who is sufficient, the God who supplies, the God who nourishes. This morning, El Shadai is visiting you. The God of more than enough is releasing more than enough strength, [music] more than enough grace, more than enough power, more than enough anointing, more than enough wisdom, more than enough provision, everything you need for this season, everything you need for this assignment, everything you need for this battle, he's releasing it now in the name of Jesus Christ. Now, open your mouth and begin to thank him. Begin to worship him. begin to magnify his name. The Bible says in Psalm 103:1-5, "Bless the Lord, oh my soul, and all that is within me, bless his holy name. Bless the Lord, oh my soul, and forget not all his benefits. Who forgives all your iniquities. Who heals all your diseases. Who redeems your life from destruction. Who crowns you with loving kindness and tender mercies. Who satisfies your mouth with good things so that your youth is renewed like the eagles. Did you see that? Your youth is renewed like the eagles. So I don't care how old you are chronologically. Spiritually, you are about to experience renewal. You are about to experience a second wind. You are about to experience fresh strength. Father, I thank you because you satisfy our mouths with good things. You crown us with loving kindness and tender mercies. You redeem our lives from destruction. So right now, I decree redemption over every person hearing this prayer. I decree that you are redeeming their time. You are redeeming their strength. You are redeeming their energy. You are redeeming their focus. You are redeeming their passion. Everything the cankerworm has eaten. Everything the locust has destroyed, everything the palmer worm has consumed, you are restoring it according to Joel 2:25. I will restore to you the years that the swarming [music] locust has eaten. So restoration is coming, restitution is coming, recovery is coming, revival is coming. Somebody's wondering, "Man of God, what if I've been tired for so long? What if this exhaustion has become chronic? What if I've lost hope of ever feeling strong again?" Let me tell you what the word says in Isaiah 43 to18:19. Do not remember the former things, nor consider the things of old. Behold, I will [music] do a new thing. Now it shall spring forth. Shall you not know it? I will even make a road in the wilderness and rivers in the desert. So God is about to do a new thing. It doesn't matter what your history has been. It doesn't matter how long you've been in this season of weariness. It doesn't matter how many times you've tried and failed to recover your strength. God is doing a new thing. And that new thing is springing forth now. Not tomorrow, not next week, not next month, now. Right now as you are hearing this word, something is shifting in the spirit realm. Right now, as we are positioned before God, something is breaking in the heavenlies. Right now, divine strength is being released. Let me pray this prayer with precision and authority. Father, I come before you in the name that is above every other name, the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. Lord, your word says in Philippians 4:13, I can do all things through Christ who strengthens me. So right now I decree that Christ is strengthening every person under the sound of my voice. The greater one who lives on the inside of them is releasing strength. The Holy Spirit who is their helper is releasing help. The father who is their source is releasing supply. I speak to every depleted area and I command it to be filled. I speak to every exhausted organ and I command it to be renewed. I speak to every tired system in their body and I command it to be refreshed. From the crown of their head to the sole of their feet, let the life of God flow. Let the power of God surge. Let the strength of God manifest. And I come against every demonic assignment that has been draining their strength. I come against every spirit of exhaustion. I come against every spirit of weariness. I come against every spirit of heaviness. I come against every spirit of discouragement. I bind you in the name of Jesus Christ. I paralyze your activities. I destroy your assignments. I render you powerless and ineffective. And I command you to release your hold now in the mighty name of Jesus. You will not steal their joy. You will not steal their peace. You will not steal their passion. You will not steal their strength. They are covered by the blood of Jesus. They are hidden in Christ. They are sealed by the Holy Spirit. And you have no legal right, no authority, no access to their lives. So I evict you. I cast you out. I drive you away in Jesus's mighty name. Now let the spirit of the Lord fill that space. Holy Spirit, you are welcome. Come and inhabit every area that has been vacated by the enemy. Come and fill every empty place. Come and occupy every void. Let your presence be the reality in their lives. Let your power be their experience. Let your peace guard their hearts and minds in Christ Jesus. Ephesians 3:16 says that he would grant you according to the riches of his glory to be strengthened with might through his spirit in the inner man. So Lord, according to the riches of your glory, not according to our lack, not according to our inadequacy, [music] not according to our weakness, but according to the riches of your glory, strengthen them with might. Strengthen them with power. Strengthen them with supernatural ability through your spirit in the inner man. You know, there's something I need you to understand about the Christian life. It is not a sprint. It is a marathon. And in a marathon, you need consistent renewal of strength. You need consistent refreshing. You need consistent grace for each face of the race. Hebrews 12:1 says, "Therefore, we also, since we are surrounded by so great a cloud of witnesses, let us lay aside every weight and the sin which so easily ens snares us, and let us run with endurance the race that is set before us." So, you need endurance. You need staying power. You need the ability to continue when others are quitting. You need the grace to press forward when others are falling back. And that grace is available this morning. Father, I ask that you will release the spirit of endurance. Release the grace of perseverance. Release the anointing of persistence. Let them be able to run and not be weary. Let them be able to walk and not fate. Let them be able to stand when others are falling. Let them be able to press when others are retreating. Let them be able to advance when others are withdrawing. Give them the spirit of Caleb who said at 85 years old, "Give me this mountain." Give them the spirit of Joshua who said, "As for me and my house, we will serve the Lord." Give them the spirit of Paul who said, "I have fought the good fight. I have finished the race. I have kept the faith." Now, I want you to make a declaration with me. Open your mouth and say this. I receive fresh strength for today. I receive divine renewal for this season. I receive supernatural refreshing from the presence of the Lord. My strength is being renewed like the eagles. My youth is being restored. My vigor is being replenished. I am strong in the Lord and in the power of his might. I can do all things through Christ [music] who strengthens me. I will not grow weary in welloing. I will not faint in the day of adversity. I am more than a conqueror through him who loved me. Greater is he that is in me than he that is in the world. The joy of the Lord is my strength. The peace of God guards my heart and mind. The power of the Holy Spirit is at work within me. I am refreshed. I am renewed. I am restored. I am revived in Jesus mighty name. Glory to God. Now let me show you something about Jesus in the gospels. In John 4, when Jesus was tired from the journey and sat by the well, the disciples went to buy food. And when they came back and urged him to eat, Jesus said something profound. I have food to eat of which you do not know. They thought he was talking about physical food. But Jesus said, "My food is to do the will of him who sent me and to finish his work." You see, there is a spiritual sustenance that comes from being in the will of God. There is a supernatural strength that comes from doing what God has called you to do. Even when you are physically tired, when you are in the center of God's will, when you are operating in your purpose, when you are functioning in your assignment, there is a grace that carries you. There is an anointing that sustains you. There is a strength that upholds you. So this morning I decree that you are being realigned with your purpose. You are being reconnected to your assignment. You are being repositioned in the will of God. And as you align with heaven's agenda, heaven's strength will be released. As you sink with divine purpose, divine power will manifest. As you engage with kingdom priorities, kingdom resources will be supplied. You will not lack. You will not fail. You will not falter. You will be like a tree planted by the rivers of water that brings forth his fruit in his season whose leaf shall not wither and whatever you do shall prosper. Father, I thank you for the anointing of the Holy Spirit. I thank you that we are not left to struggle in our own strength. I thank you that we are not abandoned to fight in our own power. I thank you that your grace is sufficient. Your strength is made perfect in weakness. So right now I ask that your strength will be manifested in their weakness. Where they are weak, you are [music] strong. Where they are limited, you are limitless. Where they are insufficient, you are all sufficient. Let them experience what Paul experienced when he said, "When I am weak, then I am strong." Let them understand what David meant when he said, "The Lord is the strength of my life. Of whom shall I be afraid?" I decree that fear is leaving, anxiety is departing, worry is dissolving, stress is breaking, and peace is flooding in. Joy is rising up, strength is being renewed, hope is being restored. Philippians 4:6-7 says, "Be anxious for nothing, but in everything by prayer and supplication with thanksgiving, let your requests be made known to God, and the peace of God which surpasses all understanding will guard your hearts and minds through Christ Jesus." So let peace guard your heart. Let peace guard your mind. Let peace stand as a sentinel over your emotions, over your thoughts, over your will, over your entire being. Now, somebody watching this needs breakthrough in their physical body. The exhaustion you're feeling is not just spiritual. There is a physical component. Maybe you've been dealing with chronic fatigue. Maybe you've been battling with illness. Maybe you've been struggling with weakness in your body. I want you to know that the same God who renews spiritual strength also renews physical strength. The same God who refreshes the spirit also heals the body. Psalm 103:3 says he forgives all your iniquities and heals all your diseases. So forgiveness and healing go together. Spiritual renewal and physical healing are connected. Father, I speak healing into their physical bodies right now. By the stripes of Jesus, they are healed. By the blood of Jesus, they are made whole. By the power of the Holy Spirit, life is flowing into every cell, every tissue, every organ, every system. I speak to blood cells [music] and I command them to function properly. I speak to immune systems and I command them to be strengthened. I speak to organs and I command them to operate at optimal capacity. I speak to bones and I command them to be strong. I speak to muscles and I command them to be firm. I speak to nerves and I command them to be steady from the top of their head to the bottom of their feet. Let the healing power of [music] God flow. Let the restoring grace of God manifest. Let the renewing strength of God be [music] evident. You see in Exodus 15:26, God revealed himself as Jehovah Rafa, the Lord who heals. He said, "If you diligently heed the voice of the Lord your God and do what is right in his sight, give ear to his commandments and keep all his statutes, I will put none of the diseases on you which I have brought on the Egyptians, for I am the Lord who heals you." So healing is part of his covenant name. Healing is part of his nature. Healing is part of what he does. And this morning, Jehovah Rafa is visiting you. The Lord who heals is touching you. The God who restores is ministering to you. Let me pray with apostolic authority. Father, by the authority you have given me [music] in Christ Jesus, I take dominion over every form of sickness, every form of disease, every form of infirmity, every form of weakness that has been attacking your children. I bind the spirit of infirmity. I bind the spirit of sickness. I bind the spirit of disease. I bind every afflicting spirit. And I command you to lose your hold and depart now in the name of Jesus Christ of Nazareth. You have no authority here. You have no legal right. You have no permission. The blood of Jesus has cancelled your assignment. The name of Jesus has revoked your license. The power of the Holy Spirit has terminated your operation. So go in Jesus's mighty name. And I decree divine health. I decree supernatural strength. I decree abundant vitality. I decree that they shall serve the Lord with gladness and come before his presence with singing. I decree that their latter days shall be greater than their former days. I decree that they shall go from strength to strength, from glory to glory, from grace to grace, from victory to victory. They shall not die but live and declare the works of the Lord. Their year shall be satisfied with long life. Their days shall be filled with divine health. Their season shall be marked by supernatural strength. Now, I want to address something about mental and emotional exhaustion. Sometimes the battle is not in the body, it's in the mind. Sometimes the weariness is not physical, it's mental. Sometimes the exhaustion is not in your circumstances, it's in your emotions. And I want you to know that God cares about your mental health. God cares about your emotional well-being. God cares about the state of your mind. 2 Corinthians 10:5 says, "Casting down arguments and every high thing that exalts itself against the knowledge of God, bringing every thought into captivity to the obedience of Christ." So there is a battle for your mind. There is a war for your thoughts. And this morning, we are taking authority over that battle. Father, I speak peace to troubled minds. I speak clarity to confused thoughts. I speak rest to anxious minds. I speak calm to restless emotions. Isaiah 26:3 says, "You will keep him in perfect peace whose mind is stayed on you because he trust in you." So Lord, help them to keep their mind stayed on you. Help them to fix their thoughts on you. Help them to focus their attention on you. And as they do, keep them in perfect peace. NOT PARTIAL PEACE, NOT temporary peace, not conditional peace, but perfect peace. Peace that passes understanding. Peace that defies circumstances. Peace that transcends situations. I come against every tormenting thought. I come against every oppressive emotion. I come against every harassing memory. I come against every disturbing imagination. and I command them to bow to the lordship of Jesus Christ. I bring every thought captive. I cast down every imagination. I pull down every stronghold. And I establish the mind of Christ in their thinking. Romans 12:2 says, "Be transformed by the renewing of your mind." So right now, I decree that their minds are being renewed. Their thinking is being transformed. Their perspectives are being shifted. Their mental frameworks are being reconstructed. They are being delivered from negative thinking, from destructive patterns, from harmful habits of thought. Glory to God. Now, let me show you something about David. This man understood spiritual exhaustion. In Psalm 42:5, he said, "Why are you cast down, oh my soul, [music] and why are you disqued within me?" You see, David was having an internal conversation. He was dealing with discouragement. He was battling with heaviness. But notice what he did. Hope in God for I shall yet praise him for the help of his countenance. David preached to himself. David encouraged himself in the Lord. David reminded his soul of who God is. And that's what I'm teaching you to do this morning. When you feel weary, preach to yourself. When you feel exhausted, remind yourself of God's promises. When you feel like giving up, declare the word of God over your situation. Open your mouth right now and speak to your own soul. Say, soul, why are you [music] cast down? Soul, why are you discouraged? Soul, hope in God. Soul, trust in the Lord. Soul, remember his faithfulness. Soul, recall his goodness. Soul, be strengthened. Soul, be encouraged. Soul be renewed. Soul be refreshed. I will praise the Lord. I will bless his name. I will magnify his greatness. I will celebrate his goodness. for he has been faithful. He has been good. He has been kind. He has been merciful. And he will continue to be all that I need. Father, I thank you that you are faithful. You are consistent. You are dependable. You are reliable. Lamentations 3:22 says, "Through the Lord's mercies, we are not consumed because his compassions fail not. They are new every morning. Great is your faithfulness. So every morning your mercies are new. Every morning your compassions are fresh. Every morning your faithfulness is demonstrated. This morning let them experience new mercy this morning. Let them receive fresh compassion this morning. Let them encounter your faithfulness [music] in a tangible way. I decree that as they go through this day, they will experience supernatural strength at the point of their need. When the demand comes, the supply will be there. When the pressure increases, the grace will increase. When the battle intensifies, the power will intensify. They will not be overcome. They will not be overwhelmed. They will not be overrun. They will overcome by the blood of the lamb and by the word of their testimony. They will overwhelm the enemy by the power of the Holy Spirit. [music] They will overrun the gates of hell by the authority of Jesus Christ. Let me address those of you who are in ministry, those of you who are serving the Lord, those of you who are on the front lines of kingdom work, there is a special grace for you this morning. There is a particular anointing being released over your life. Isaiah 40-29 says he gives power to the weak and to those who have no might, he increases strength. So if you feel like you have no might, this is your moment. If you feel powerless, [music] this is your season. God is about to increase your strength. He's about to multiply [music] your capacity. He's about to expand your ability. You will minister with fresh anointing. You will serve with renewed passion. You will function with increased effectiveness. Father, I speak to every minister, every servant, every leader, every worker in the kingdom of God. I decree that the anointing upon their lives is being renewed. The oil is being replenished. The fire is being rekindled. The zeal is being restored. Numbers 11:17 says, "I will take of the spirit that is upon you and will put the same upon them." So Lord, take of your spirit and pour it fresh upon them. Let them not operate on yesterday's anointing. Let them not function on last season's grace. Let them not rely on old mantels. Give them fresh oil. Give them new wine. Give them current anointing for current assignments. Give them present grace for present challenges. I come against the spirit of burnout. I come against the spirit of ministry fatigue. I come against the spirit of compassion fatigue. And I decree that you will not burn out. You will burn on. You will not fade away. You will shine brighter. You will not diminish. You will increase. John 15:16 says, "You did not choose me, but I chose you and appointed you that you should go and bear fruit and that your fruit should remain. So the fruit of your labor will remain. The results of your ministry will endure. The impact of your service will last. You are not laboring in vain. You are not spending your strength for nothing. Your work in the Lord is not empty. It is producing. It is multiplying. It is expanding." Now, I want to speak to the issue of weariness in waiting. Some of you are tired not because of what you're doing, but because of what you're waiting for. You're waiting for the promise. You're waiting for the breakthrough. You're waiting for the manifestation. You're waiting for the answer. And the prolonged waiting has worn you down. But I want you to hear what the word says in Isaiah 40:31. But those who wait on the Lord shall renew their strength. There's something about waiting on the Lord that produces renewal. There's something about patient expectation that generates strength. There's something about steadfast hope that creates endurance. Father, I speak to those who are in seasons of waiting. I decree that their waiting is not wasted. Their delays are not denials. Their timing is not off. You are working all things together for their good. You are orchestrating circumstances for their benefit. You are aligning situations for their advantage. So I speak patience. I speak endurance. I speak perseverance. I speak faithfulness. Let them wait on you with confident expectation. Let them trust in [music] you with unwavering faith. Let them hope in you with steadfast assurance. And as they wait, renew their strength. As they trust, increase their capacity. As they hope, multiply their grace. Habac 2:3 says, "For the vision is yet for an appointed time, but at the end it will speak and it will not lie. Though it tries, wait for it because it will surely come, it will not tarry. So the promise will come, the breakthrough will manifest, the answer will arrive. It's not a matter of if, it's a matter of when. and that when is determined by God's perfect timing, not human impatience. So I decree that you will have the grace to wait. You will have the strength to endure. You will have the faith to persist. And when the appointed time comes, you will see the manifestation of everything God has spoken over your life. Let me close with this powerful prayer. Lift up your hands one more time. Father, I thank you for what you've done in this place of prayer. I thank you for the refreshing that has come. I thank you for the renewal that has been released. I thank you for the strength that has been imparted. Now I ask that you will seal this work. Let it not be temporary. Let it not be fleeting. Let it not be momentary, but let it be lasting. Let it be enduring. Let it be permanent. Seal it by your spirit. Confirm it by your word. Establish it by your power. And I decree that from this day forward, they will walk in supernatural strength. They will function in divine energy. They will operate in Holy Ghost power. Their steps will be ordered. Their paths will be directed. Their ways will be established. They will be like trees planted by rivers of water. They will be like eagles that soar on the wind. They will be like soldiers that march in formation. strong, steady, sure, unwavering, unshakable, unmovable, always abounding in the work of the Lord, knowing that their labor is not in vain [music] in the Lord. I bless you in the name of the Father, the Son, and the Holy Spirit. I bless your spirit, soul, and body. I bless your going out and your coming in. I bless your rising up and your lying down. I bless your work and your rest. I bless your family and your future. I bless your present and your destiny. The Lord bless you and keep you. The Lord make his face shine upon you [music] and be gracious to you. The Lord lift up his countenance upon you and give you peace. And may the grace of our Lord Jesus Christ, the love of God the Father, and the fellowship of the Holy Spirit be with you now and forever more in Jesus mighty, matchless, magnificent, marvelous name. Amen and amen. Now go forth in strength.
